sources.title: One Thousand and One Nights

sources.excerpt: She told him a story that night, and when dawn came, she fell silent, leaving the tale unfinished.

This historical source from 800 provides valuable insight into the mena region during the medieval period. Such primary sources are essential for understanding not just the major events of history, but the daily lives, beliefs, and struggles of ordinary people across different cultures and time periods.

sources.excerpt: I am sending you, my brother, five pounds of flax and ask you to buy me with the proceeds a piece of lead and some olive oil.

sources.excerpt: The markets of Damascus are the most beautiful in the world. Each craft has its own bazaar, and no other trade mingles with it.

sources.title: The Book of Dishes
sources.author: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Baghdadi
sources.excerpt: Take fat young meat, cut into middling pieces. Put in the saucepan with a little salt, cover with water and boil, removing the scum.

sources.title: Book of Agriculture

sources.excerpt: The olive tree thrives in mountainous and stony ground. Plant it in autumn, for trees planted then take root before winter cold arrives.

sources.excerpt: Bedouins are closer to the first natural state and more remote from the evil habits that have infected the hearts of settlers.
